name: resilience-runtime-proof
truth_boundary: This contract proves only the checked resilience behavior observed in the GitHub-hosted Docker Compose environment. It is not production readiness, load testing, chaos-engineering certification, target-PC validation, or proof of optional Syntra/Aetheris workstation and browser integrations.

checks.claim: Gateway actuator health reports UP before the resilience exercise.
Identity-service actuator health reports UP before authentication.
User-service actuator health reports UP before the outage.
An authenticated user read succeeds through the gateway before the outage.
The userReadCircuit is CLOSED after a successful baseline request.
Stopping user-service produces the configured structured HTTP 503 fallback through the gateway.
Repeated downstream failures drive userReadCircuit into OPEN state.
A request while the circuit is OPEN is rejected by the circuit breaker and increments notPermittedCalls.
Gateway actuator health remains UP while user-service is unavailable.
The stopped user-service can restart and return to actuator health UP.
After the configured open-state wait, userReadCircuit transitions to HALF_OPEN without restarting the gateway.
Successful half-open probes close userReadCircuit after downstream recovery.
The authenticated user read returns HTTP 200 again after circuit recovery.
